limitations: Copied public scans and generated rigid poses are an identity execution control, not independent two-sensor accuracy; raw scan windows are not motion compensated.
Wall includes fresh imports, raw reads, GPU construction/compilation, full blocked evaluation, input hashes and saves. Parent guards/aggregation are excluded.

CPU and GPU reductions/eigensolves have different arithmetic. Full evaluation numeric fields use abs 1e-9/rel 1e-6; covariance abs 1e-13/rel 1e-5. Every status/count/decision/string matches exactly; only execution identity differs.
Prepared points and original raw-input hashes must match. No separate warmup, timing exclusions or point subsampling. Separate compiler caches start empty.
Single public sequence on a shared host; descriptive timings are not portable guarantees.
